song.name: Rising Tide
song.plot: As the Covenant expands, the soul-banking accelerates. Acheron notices a disturbing phenomenon: the stored soul energy is beginning to resonate with the dormant Nyktoros in the Void.
song.analysis: The original is a generic "rising resistance / force of light" piece with heavy filler. The reworked version anchors it to the actual turn in the Covenant arc (~200 BGD): the soul-bank resonating with dormant Nyktoros, Acheron realizing the Thirst was designed as a cosmic soul-harvest trap. Uniform 8-8-8-8 meter (adjusted from the master: "Energy vaults begin to grow", "Reaching the sleeping master's face", "The rising tide of power stored", "As tragic horror now unfolds", "He sees the trap in blueprint grand"). Suggested song direction: tense, ominous, accelerating — rising strings, heartbeat drums, sub-bass swells, creeping dread.
